scenarios.name: colored-mana-unavailable-without-artifact
scenarios.why: No artifact is controlled, so the restriction on the any-color mana ability is not met.

scenarios.name: colored-mana-offered-with-artifact
scenarios.why: Bonesplitter is an artifact controlled by the player, satisfying the ability's condition.

scenarios.name: colored-mana-activation-pays-one-life
scenarios.why: With an artifact controlled, the ability can be activated; its costs tap the Spire and pay one life before it adds one mana.

scenarios.name: colorless-mana-activates-unrestricted
scenarios.why: The colorless-producing ability carries no artifact restriction; activating it taps the Spire without paying life and adds colorless mana.
